items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: we had to take and get George Smith, hired George Smith to play the shows for Paul Barbaran.

ctx.x: He, was a kind of slow reader, yeah. You see. But that was, I never, I never, I never get a chance to ask him for that. Being why. Oh, I, I'm going to ask one, excuse me to interrupt, is Paul Barbaran with you at Doug's time? Paul Barbaran came with us then too. Yeah, Paul was playing the bill. Because you see, Snaggs was with us at the Lincoln Gardens. Yes.

And he was with us at the Lincoln Gardens. And he was with us at the Lincoln Gardens. And he was with us at the Lincoln Gardens. And he was with us at the Lincoln Gardens. You see, and that's it, by getting Lewis Russell and everything, he thought he'd get Paul Barbaran to send his man. But, because, well you didn't know. Because see the plantation, the first time it was a cabaret, heavy cabaret. And we didn't know whether Snaggs could make the job, be able to hold a job or not. Even though he's a good, I mean…
Yeah, he was a straight drummer. Oh he's a straight, just a straight drummer, you see.
